senses.en: someone held captive to force others to meet demands

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on hostage negotiations.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论人质谈判。

ex.en: A campus survey used hostage negotiations to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用人质谈判来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: take someone hostage｜劫持某人作人质
hold someone hostage｜扣押某人作人质
tip: take或hold someone hostage中，hostage前不加冠词。

senses.en: Different from what is usual or expected, often causing concern.

ex.en: Office hours began with abnormal behaviour.
ex.zh: 答疑从反常行为开始。

ex.en: The author returns to abnormal behaviour when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了反常行为。

tip: 常用于医学或异常现象，不宜随意用来评价人。

senses.en: Improve the quality, value, or appeal of something

ex.en: The professor asked us to enhance performance.
ex.zh: 教授让我们提升表现。

ex.en: The reading asks you to enhance performance and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你提升表现，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: enhance the quality of｜改善……的质量
enhance someone's reputation｜提升某人的声誉
tip: 强调质量、效果或价值提升，不单指数量增加。

senses.en: Musical instruments played by hitting, shaking, or scraping them.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on percussion instruments.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论打击乐器。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around percussion instruments.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕打击乐器展开说明。

tip: 总称时不可数；一件打击乐器用a percussion instrument。

senses.en: To give someone money or something else for loss or harm.
To balance a disadvantage by providing something beneficial.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer compensate for a lack of during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时弥补……的不足。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to compensate for a lack of.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们弥补……的不足。

col: compensate someone for a loss｜赔偿某人的损失
compensate for a lack of｜弥补……的不足
tip: 赔偿某人用compensate sb for sth；弥补用for。

senses.en: To do something illegal or seriously wrong.
To promise firmly to do something or support someone.
To make money, time, or resources available for a purpose.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to commit a crime.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求犯罪。

ex.en: The reading asks you to commit a crime and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你犯罪，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: commit to doing something｜承诺做某事
tip: commit to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: To give time, effort, or resources to someone or something.

ex.en: The assignment is to devote time to, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先投入时间于，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to devote time to.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们投入时间于。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: The personality and qualities that make you who you are.

ex.en: Office hours began with a sense of self.
ex.zh: 答疑从自我意识开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a sense of self.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自我意识的材料。

col: a sense of self｜自我意识
your usual self｜你平常的状态
tip: self是名词；表达“我自己”通常用myself。

senses.en: Relating to teeth or their care and treatment

ex.en: I copied dental care into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把牙齿保健抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dental care.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论牙齿保健的材料。

tip: dental是形容词；牙医是dentist。

senses.en: To move slowly, carried by water or air.
To move or change gradually without clear purpose or control.
The general meaning of what someone says or writes.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to drift apart.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求逐渐疏远。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers drift apart before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要逐渐疏远。

col: drift off to sleep｜渐渐入睡
tip: drift强调随水、风移动，或缺乏明确方向。

senses.en: to change behaviour or features to suit new conditions
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to adapt to change.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须适应变化。

ex.en: The reading asks you to adapt to change and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你适应变化，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: A strong desire for something, or something causing that desire.

ex.en: Our professor circled resist temptation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了抵制诱惑。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of resist temptation.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得抵制诱惑这个例子。

col: give in to temptation｜经不住诱惑
the temptation to do something｜做某事的诱惑
tip: 常用the temptation to do，表示想做某事的诱惑。

senses.en: a thick roll of dried tobacco leaves made for smoking

ex.en: I copied cigar smoke into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把雪茄烟雾抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects cigar smoke with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把雪茄烟雾和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: cigar是雪茄；cigarette是通常用纸卷制的香烟。

senses.en: Felt or done by each person towards the other.
Shared by two or more people or groups.

ex.en: Our professor circled mutual respect on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了相互尊重。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mutual respect.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕相互尊重展开说明。

tip: mutual friend是共同朋友，不是彼此的朋友。

senses.en: the quality of being kind and morally good
the substances in food that help keep you healthy
used to express surprise, worry, or shock

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about natural goodness.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于天然营养的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss natural goodness.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论天然营养的材料。

col: out of the goodness of your heart｜纯粹出于好心
tip: 作名词通常不可数；My goodness表示惊讶。

senses.en: A black material made by heating wood with little air.
Charcoal sticks used for drawing.

ex.en: Office hours began with activated charcoal.
ex.zh: 答疑从活性炭开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of activated charcoal.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得活性炭这个例子。

tip: charcoal通常不可数；coal是煤，不是木炭。

senses.en: One of the curved bones surrounding the chest.
A piece of meat containing an animal's rib bones.
To tease someone in a friendly way.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on broken rib.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论断裂的肋骨。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of broken rib.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得断裂的肋骨这个例子。

col: rib someone about something｜拿某事善意地取笑某人
tip: 表示排骨通常用复数ribs；动词rib属非正式用法。

senses.en: Feeling unhappy because you lack company
Quiet and remote, with few or no people

ex.en: The textbook introduces a lonesome road in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一条偏僻冷清的路。

ex.en: A campus survey used a lonesome road to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用一条偏僻冷清的路来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: a lonesome road｜一条偏僻冷清的路
tip: 多见于美式英语；lonely更通用，alone只表示独自一人。

senses.en: A box holding a dead person's body for burial or cremation.

ex.en: Our professor circled a wooden coffin on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了木棺。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a wooden coffin.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得木棺这个例子。

col: a nail in the coffin｜促使失败的因素
tip: casket在美式英语中也常指棺材。

senses.en: an act of buying, selling, or exchanging money

ex.en: The textbook introduces financial transaction in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了金融交易。

ex.en: The reading connects financial transaction with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把金融交易和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常可数：一笔交易是a transaction。

senses.en: To produce young, or keep animals to produce young.
A group of domestic animals sharing particular inherited characteristics.
To cause something, especially something harmful, to develop.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to breed animals.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何繁育动物。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers breed animals before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要繁育动物。

col: a breed of dog｜一种犬种
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bred；品种breed不同于物种species。

senses.en: A fibre carrying signals between the brain and body.
The courage to do something difficult or frightening.
Rude confidence that makes someone behave without respect.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on nerve damage.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论神经损伤。

ex.en: The reading connects nerve damage with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把神经损伤和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: have the nerve to do something｜竟敢做某事
tip: nerve指勇气常不可数；nerves可指紧张情绪。

senses.en: A suggested plan for others to consider.
An act of asking someone to marry you.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a marriage proposal in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了求婚。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a marriage proposal.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得求婚这个例子。

col: put forward a proposal｜提出方案
a proposal to do something｜做某事的提议
tip: proposal to do表示做某事的提议，通常为可数名词。

senses.zh: 不破坏环境的；可持续的
senses.en: Using resources without exhausting them or causing lasting environmental damage.
Able to continue over a long period.

ex.en: Office hours began with sustainable development.
ex.zh: 答疑从可持续发展开始。

ex.en: The author returns to sustainable development when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可持续发展。

tip: renewable强调可再生；sustainable强调可持续。

senses.en: Objects shaped from clay and hardened by heating.
The activity of making objects from clay.
A place where clay objects are made.

ex.en: I copied handmade pottery into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把手工陶器抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of handmade pottery.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得手工陶器这个例子。

tip: 指陶器统称时不可数；一件用a piece of pottery。

senses.en: the need to rely on someone or something
a strong physical or mental need for a substance

ex.en: The textbook introduces reduce dependence in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了减少依赖。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of reduce dependence.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得减少依赖这个例子。

tip: 固定搭配dependence on，不用dependence of。

senses.en: preferring traditional ideas and avoiding major changes
deliberately low or cautious to avoid overestimating
someone who favours traditional values and limited change

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on conservative views.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论保守观点。

ex.en: The reading connects conservative views with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把保守观点和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 小写通常指保守；大写可表示保守党的。

senses.en: a round root vegetable, usually white with a purple top

ex.en: Our professor circled turnip greens on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了芜菁叶。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss turnip greens.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论芜菁叶的材料。

tip: 指芜菁；不要与radish（萝卜）或swede（芜菁甘蓝）混淆。

senses.en: Someone who directs an orchestra or choir
A material that allows heat or electricity to pass through
Someone who checks or sells tickets on public transport

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an orchestra conductor.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于管弦乐队指挥的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an orchestra conductor.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论管弦乐队指挥的材料。

col: an orchestra conductor｜管弦乐队指挥
a good conductor of heat｜热的良导体
tip: 导体常搭配of heat或of electricity。

senses.en: meet someone or experience something, especially unexpectedly
an unexpected meeting or experience involving someone or something

ex.en: The lab instructions say to encounter difficulties.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求遇到困难。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to encounter difficulties.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得遇到困难。

tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an encounter with。

senses.en: A chemical substance with a pH below seven.
Containing acid or having a sharp, sour taste.
Expressing criticism in a sharp and unkind way.

ex.en: I copied stomach acid into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把胃酸抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to stomach acid when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了胃酸。

tip: acid可作名词或形容词；acidic常指呈酸性的。

senses.en: a part or share of a whole
the relationship in size or amount between things

ex.en: Office hours began with out of proportion.
ex.zh: 答疑从不成比例开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss out of proportion.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论不成比例的材料。

col: a large proportion of｜很大一部分
tip: a proportion of后谓语单复数取决于所指名词。

senses.en: with continuing loyalty or commitment
in a way that accurately matches the original

ex.en: After the lecture, we used faithfully in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了忠诚地。

ex.en: Students who can explain faithfully usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
ex.zh: 能解释忠诚地的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。

col: Yours faithfully｜谨上（正式信函结尾）
tip: 英式正式信函不知收信人姓名时常用Yours faithfully。

senses.en: An act of saying goodbye, especially before a long separation.
Used to say goodbye in a formal or emotional way.
Held or given to mark someone's departure.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a fond farewell in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了深情的告别。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a fond farewell.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕深情的告别展开说明。

tip: 比goodbye正式，常用于长久分别或郑重告别。

senses.en: A group of birds, sheep, or goats
Go or gather somewhere in large numbers

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a flock of sheep.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一群羊的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a flock of sheep.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一群羊展开说明。

tip: 鸟群、羊群常用flock；牛群通常用herd。

senses.en: A machine that converts other forms of energy into electricity.
A device or program that produces something.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a backup generator.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于备用发电机的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a backup generator to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用备用发电机来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

col: a random number generator｜随机数生成器
tip: 由generate加-or构成，既指机器也可指程序。

senses.en: A substance used to kill pests that damage crops.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on pesticide use.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论农药使用。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of pesticide use.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得农药使用这个例子。

col: reduce pesticide use｜减少农药使用
tip: pesticide泛指农药；insecticide专指杀虫剂。

senses.en: A conflict between people, ideas, or scheduled events.
To conflict, occur simultaneously, or look unpleasant together.
A loud ringing sound made when metal objects strike together.

ex.en: I copied a scheduling clash into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把日程冲突抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a scheduling clash when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了日程冲突。

col: a clash of interests｜利益冲突
a clash of cymbals｜铙钹撞击声
tip: clash with可指时间冲突、意见相左或颜色不搭。

senses.en: A number with a fractional part shown after a point.
Using a system based on ten or involving decimal fractions.

ex.en: The textbook introduces decimal point in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了小数点。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss decimal point.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论小数点的材料。

tip: 保留两位小数可说to two decimal places。

senses.en: An organ that processes nutrients and removes harmful substances from blood.
An animal's liver prepared or eaten as food.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on liver disease.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肝病。

ex.en: A campus survey used liver disease to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用肝病来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 指器官常说 the liver；作食物时通常不可数。

senses.en: Used in phrases meaning representing someone or supporting their interests.

ex.en: Office hours began with act on behalf of.
ex.zh: 答疑从代表……行事开始。

ex.en: The author returns to act on behalf of when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了代表……行事。

col: on behalf of someone｜代表某人
on someone's behalf｜代表某人；为某人
act on behalf of｜代表……行事
tip: 通常用于on behalf of或on someone's behalf。

senses.en: A curved transparent piece that focuses or spreads light.
The transparent part inside the eye that focuses light.

ex.en: Office hours began with camera lens.
ex.zh: 答疑从相机镜头开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of camera lens.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得相机镜头这个例子。

tip: 复数为lenses；隐形眼镜常用contact lenses。

senses.en: Very much, especially in relation to feelings or beliefs
Far into something or a long way below the surface

ex.en: The lab manual says to deeply concerned before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先深感担忧的，再记下数字。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will deeply concerned when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会深感担忧的。

tip: 表示程度时常修饰情感词，如 deeply worried。

senses.en: a sea animal with a soft body and eight arms

ex.en: I copied a giant octopus into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把一只巨型章鱼抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a giant octopus.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一只巨型章鱼展开说明。

col: a giant octopus｜一只巨型章鱼
tip: 常用复数是octopuses；腕通常称arms。

senses.en: having a particular role or condition in the past
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: Office hours began with former colleague.
ex.zh: 答疑从以前的同事开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of former colleague.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得以前的同事这个例子。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: The scientific study of stars, planets, and space.

ex.en: Office hours began with observational astronomy.
ex.zh: 答疑从观测天文学开始。

ex.en: The reading connects observational astronomy with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把观测天文学和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: astronomy是天文学；astrology是占星术。

senses.en: A connected path through which an electric current can flow
A route around an area, or one journey around it
A series of places visited for similar events or activities

ex.en: Office hours began with electrical circuit.
ex.zh: 答疑从电路开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss electrical circuit.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电路的材料。

tip: 电路和环形路线都可用circuit；short circuit指短路。

senses.en: Easy to see, understand, or recognize.

ex.en: I copied clearly evident into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把十分明显的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around clearly evident.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕十分明显的展开说明。

tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

senses.en: a game where randomly chosen tickets win prizes
a selection process or situation whose outcome depends on chance

ex.en: The textbook introduces a lottery ticket in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一张彩票。

ex.en: The reading connects a lottery ticket with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一张彩票和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: by lottery指通过抽签，不一定涉及购买彩票。

senses.en: the sale of goods directly to consumers
relating to selling goods directly to consumers
to sell goods to consumers, often at a stated price

ex.en: I copied online retail into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把网络零售抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used online retail to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用网络零售来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: retail面向消费者零售；wholesale指批发。

senses.en: A deep valley with steep sides, often containing a river.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about deep canyon.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于深邃的峡谷的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deep canyon.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论深邃的峡谷的材料。

tip: canyon强调谷深、两侧陡峭；valley泛指山谷。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of anger.
Express extreme anger in a fierce or uncontrolled way.
Continue with great force, causing danger or disruption.

ex.en: I copied shake with rage into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把气得发抖抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around shake with rage.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕气得发抖展开说明。

col: fly into a rage｜勃然大怒
tip: rage比anger强烈；all the rage表示“风靡一时”。

senses.en: a violently rotating column of air reaching down from a cloud

ex.en: Our professor circled a powerful tornado on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了强烈的龙卷风。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a powerful tornado.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论强烈的龙卷风的材料。

col: a powerful tornado｜强烈的龙卷风
tornado damage｜龙卷风造成的破坏
tip: 复数可写tornadoes或tornados。

senses.en: A natural tendency to behave without learning or conscious thought.
A feeling about something that does not involve conscious reasoning.

ex.en: I copied survival instinct into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把生存本能抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects survival instinct with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把生存本能和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: trust your instincts｜相信自己的直觉
an instinct for｜对……的天生能力
tip: instinct常指先天本能；intuition偏指直觉判断。

senses.en: A special right or advantage available only to certain people.
An opportunity to do something regarded as a special honour.

ex.en: Our professor circled a rare privilege on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了难得的荣幸。

ex.en: A campus survey used a rare privilege to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用难得的荣幸来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 表示荣幸常用have the privilege of doing。

senses.en: causing strong disagreement or public debate

ex.en: The textbook introduces highly controversial in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了极具争议的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly controversial.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕极具争议的展开说明。

col: a controversial issue｜有争议的问题
a controversial decision｜有争议的决定
tip: 表示引发分歧，不等于错误或不受欢迎。

senses.en: not enough for a particular need or purpose

ex.en: Our professor circled insufficient funds on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了资金不足。

ex.en: The reading connects insufficient funds with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把资金不足和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: insufficient to meet demand｜不足以满足需求
tip: 较正式；常用insufficient for或insufficient to do。

senses.en: The activity of watching television, films, or other visual material.
An arranged opportunity to inspect a property or see something.
Looking at something or considering it in a particular way.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about television viewing.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于收看电视的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around television viewing.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕收看电视展开说明。

col: a private viewing｜私人专场参观
tip: 作名词可指收看活动；a viewing常指一次看房。

senses.en: The ability to learn, understand, and solve problems.
Secret information gathered about other countries or possible threats.

ex.en: I copied artificial intelligence into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把人工智能抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects artificial intelligence with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把人工智能和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常不可数；intelligence agency指情报机构。

senses.en: having three straight sides and three angles
involving three people, groups, or countries

ex.en: Office hours began with triangular shape.
ex.zh: 答疑从三角形开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of triangular shape.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得三角形这个例子。

tip: triangle是名词；triangular是形容词。

senses.en: A lesson where a tutor teaches individuals or small groups.
A guide that teaches a skill through clear steps.

ex.en: Our professor circled video tutorial on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了视频教程。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss video tutorial.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论视频教程的材料。

tip: 可指小班辅导课，也可指纸质或视频教程。

senses.en: Available in large amounts or numbers.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a plentiful supply.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于充足的供应的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a plentiful supply.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得充足的供应这个例子。

tip: 表示物资或机会充足，不表示一个人富有。

senses.zh: 心理学家；心理专业人员
senses.en: An expert who studies the mind or helps with psychological problems.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about clinical psychologist.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于临床心理学家的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around clinical psychologist.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕临床心理学家展开说明。

col: consult a psychologist｜咨询心理专业人员
tip: 词首p不发音；不等同于精神科医生psychiatrist。

senses.en: The thick main stem of a tree.
An elephant's long nose, used for breathing and holding things.
The enclosed space in a car for carrying luggage.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about tree trunk.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于树干的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to tree trunk when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了树干。

tip: 汽车后备箱美式用trunk，英式用boot。

senses.en: Relating to literature or the study of it.

senses.zh: 书面语的；有文学色彩的
senses.en: Typical of formal or artistic writing rather than everyday speech.

ex.en: I copied literary works into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把文学作品抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to literary works when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了文学作品。

tip: literary是文学的；literal是字面的。

senses.en: great respect or recognition for someone's qualities or achievements
show respect or give public recognition to someone
do what a promise or agreement requires

ex.en: I copied a great honor into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把莫大的荣幸抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a great honor.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论莫大的荣幸的材料。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为honour，h不发音。

senses.en: A person's social position or standing within a group.
The current condition or situation of someone or something.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about social status.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于社会地位的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of social status.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得社会地位这个例子。

tip: 既可指社会地位，也可指当前状况，注意语境。

senses.en: available to choose but not required

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on entirely optional.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论完全自愿的。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss entirely optional.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论完全自愿的的材料。

tip: optional表示不强制，不是“随便的”或“随机的”。

senses.en: how often something happens within a particular period
the number of wave cycles or vibrations per second

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about high frequency.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于高频的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss high frequency.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论高频的材料。

col: with increasing frequency｜越来越频繁地
tip: 频率高低用high或low；发生得多不等于速度快。

senses.en: To show clearly that something is true or exists.
To show someone how something works or is done.
To gather publicly to express support or opposition.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer demonstrate that during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时表明……。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to demonstrate that.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得表明……。

col: demonstrate a commitment to｜体现对……的投入
tip: 证明某事常用demonstrate that从句。

senses.en: The feeling that someone or something is wrong or unacceptable.

ex.en: Our professor circled express disapproval on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了表示不赞同。

ex.en: A campus survey used express disapproval to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用表示不赞同来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: disapproval of something｜对某事的不满
a look of disapproval｜不赞同的神情
tip: 通常不可数；对某事不赞同用disapproval of。

senses.en: Showing reasonable judgment rather than extreme or foolish thinking.
Able to think clearly and understand reality.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a sane approach.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于明智的处理方式的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a sane approach.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得明智的处理方式这个例子。

col: a sane approach｜明智的处理方式
keep someone sane｜使某人保持理智
tip: 表示明智时近于sensible；并非所有心理疾病都影响理智。

senses.en: To breathe out slowly and audibly, expressing feelings
A slow, audible breath expressing sadness, tiredness, or relief

ex.en: I heard the lecturer sigh deeply during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时深深叹气。

ex.en: The passage says students who can sigh deeply follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够深深叹气的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: a sigh of relief｜如释重负的叹息
let out a sigh｜叹一口气
tip: gh不发音；叹气也可表示放松，不一定是悲伤。

senses.en: completely sure that something is true or right

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fully convinced.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论完全信服。

ex.en: The author returns to fully convinced when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了完全信服。

tip: 人感到信服用convinced；事物有说服力用convincing。

senses.en: Belonging to the present time.
Existing or happening during the same period.
A person who lives at the same time as another.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about contemporary art.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于当代艺术的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of contemporary art.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得当代艺术这个例子。

col: a contemporary of someone｜与某人同时代的人
tip: 当代艺术中指“当代”；历史语境也可指“当时的”。

senses.en: A musical piece or passage performed by one person.
Done or performed by one person alone.
Alone, without other people helping or taking part.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a piano solo.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于钢琴独奏的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to a piano solo when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了钢琴独奏。

tip: 可作名词、形容词和副词；独奏者用soloist。

senses.en: small stones used to cover paths or make concrete

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about gravel path.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于碎石小径的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to gravel path when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了碎石小径。

tip: 通常不可数；单颗小石子可用a pebble。

senses.en: the subjects and content included in a programme of study

ex.en: Office hours began with school curriculum.
ex.zh: 答疑从学校课程体系开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around school curriculum.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕学校课程体系展开说明。

tip: 复数为curricula或curriculums；不等于单门课。

senses.en: The health, happiness, and good living conditions of people.
Public support for people who need money or care.

ex.en: Our professor circled animal welfare on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了动物福利。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of animal welfare.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得动物福利这个例子。

tip: 不可数名词；作前置修饰语时也仍是名词。

senses.en: Causing people to feel insulted, upset, or disgusted.
Intended or used for attacking rather than defending.
An organized attack or campaign to achieve a goal.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about offensive language.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于冒犯性语言的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of offensive language.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得冒犯性语言这个例子。

col: find something offensive｜觉得某事令人反感
tip: 表示觉得被冒犯用offended，不用offensive。

senses.en: land controlled by a particular country or authority
an area an animal defends against others of its kind
an area of knowledge, experience, or activity

ex.en: I copied national territory into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把国家领土抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to national territory when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了国家领土。

col: defend territory｜保卫领土；守卫领地
tip: 领土义可不可数；一块辖区可用a territory。

senses.en: A large building where goods are stored before distribution
Store goods in a warehouse

ex.en: The textbook introduces automated warehouse in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自动化仓库。

ex.en: A campus survey used automated warehouse to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用自动化仓库来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 指储存货物的大型建筑；动词用法较正式。

senses.en: The state of being known by many people.

ex.en: Our professor circled achieve fame on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了成名。

ex.en: A campus survey used achieve fame to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用成名来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

tip: fame通常不可数；形容词famous常接for。

senses.en: existing or happening before something else

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on prior experience.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论先前的经验。

ex.en: The reading connects prior experience with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把先前的经验和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: prior常放名词前；prior to相当于before。

senses.en: Wastewater and human waste carried away through drains

ex.en: I copied raw sewage into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把未经处理的污水抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss raw sewage.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论未经处理的污水的材料。

tip: 不可数；sewage是污水，sewer才是下水道。

senses.en: A comparison showing the relative sizes of two quantities.

ex.en: Our professor circled student-teacher ratio on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了生师比。

ex.en: A campus survey used student-teacher ratio to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用生师比来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: the ratio of A to B｜A与B之比
tip: A与B之比用the ratio of A to B，注意顺序。

senses.en: A survey asking people about their opinions or preferences
The process of voting in an election
To survey people's opinions, or receive votes in an election

ex.en: Our professor circled opinion poll on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了民意调查。

ex.en: The reading connects opinion poll with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把民意调查和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: conduct a poll｜开展民意调查
go to the polls｜前往投票
tip: 民调常用opinion poll；the polls指选举投票。

senses.en: The places, objects, and conditions around a person or thing.

ex.en: Office hours began with peaceful surroundings.
ex.zh: 答疑从宁静的环境开始。

ex.en: The reading connects peaceful surroundings with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把宁静的环境和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 始终用复数形式，作主语时谓语也用复数。

senses.en: Too unpleasant, painful, or intense to tolerate

ex.en: Our professor circled unbearable pain on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了难以忍受的疼痛。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around unbearable pain.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕难以忍受的疼痛展开说明。

col: unbearable noise｜令人无法忍受的噪声
tip: 这里的bear指忍受；unbearable语气很强。

senses.en: a device that removes unwanted substances from liquid or air
to remove unwanted substances or select information using particular conditions
to pass through or spread gradually

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on air filter.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论空气过滤器。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of air filter.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得空气过滤器这个例子。

col: filter search results｜筛选搜索结果
tip: filter out后接被滤除的东西，不是保留下来的。

senses.en: to use resources, energy, or time
to eat food or drink liquids
to fill someone's mind or destroy something completely

ex.en: The professor asked us to consume energy.
ex.zh: 教授让我们消耗能源。

ex.en: The passage says students who can consume energy follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够消耗能源的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: be consumed by fear｜内心充满恐惧
tip: 表示吃喝时比eat、drink正式；名词为consumption。

senses.en: Feel very worried about something unpleasant that may happen.
Strong fear or worry about something that may happen.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to dread doing something.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何害怕做某事。

ex.en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to dread doing something.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们害怕做某事。

col: fill someone with dread｜使某人充满恐惧
tip: 表示害怕做某事通常用 dread doing。

senses.en: A description of connected events, real or imagined.
A particular account used to explain events and shape understanding.
Related to telling stories or describing connected events.

ex.en: Office hours began with personal narrative.
ex.zh: 答疑从个人叙事开始。

ex.en: The reading connects personal narrative with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把个人叙事和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 作名词指故事或叙述；作形容词常修饰结构、技巧。

senses.en: a sudden release of lava, ash, and gases from a volcano
a sudden, forceful outbreak of an emotion or activity

ex.en: Office hours began with volcanic eruption.
ex.zh: 答疑从火山喷发开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around volcanic eruption.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕火山喷发展开说明。

col: an eruption of anger｜怒火的爆发
predict an eruption｜预测火山喷发
tip: 常与volcanic搭配；也可指情绪等突然爆发。

senses.en: A separate condition or requirement in a legal document.
A group of words containing a subject and a verb.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about main clause.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于主句的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss main clause.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论主句的材料。

col: a clause in a contract｜合同中的条款
include a clause｜加入一项条款
tip: 语法中clause含主语和谓语；phrase通常不含。

senses.en: To arrange regular access to a publication or service.
To agree with a particular belief or view.

ex.en: The assignment is to subscribe to a magazine, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先订阅杂志，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on public communication showed why researchers subscribe to a magazine before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共传播的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要订阅杂志。

col: subscribe to a magazine｜订阅杂志
subscribe to a channel｜订阅频道
subscribe to the view that｜赞同……的观点
tip: 订阅和赞同都常用subscribe to，to是介词。

senses.en: The hard, pointed mouth of a bird.

ex.en: I copied a sharp beak into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把尖锐的鸟喙抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sharp beak.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕尖锐的鸟喙展开说明。

tip: 鸟嘴可说beak或bill；人的嘴通常用mouth。

senses.en: A repeated section of a song, usually with unchanged words.
A group singing together, or many voices sounding together.
To say or sing something together at the same time.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a chorus of approval.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一片赞同声的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a chorus of approval with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一片赞同声和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: join in the chorus｜加入副歌合唱
a chorus of approval｜一片赞同声
tip: 歌曲的chorus是反复出现的副歌，与verse主歌相对。

senses.en: giving help, encouragement, or understanding

ex.en: Our professor circled a supportive family on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了给予支持的家庭。

ex.en: A campus survey used a supportive family to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用给予支持的家庭来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: a supportive family｜给予支持的家庭
a supportive environment｜支持性的环境
tip: 常用be supportive of表示支持某人或某事。

senses.en: completely, used to strongly emphasise a description

ex.en: The lab manual says to utterly exhausted before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先筋疲力尽，再记下数字。

ex.en: Students who utterly exhausted are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够筋疲力尽的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 常修饰强烈或负面形容词，如 impossible、ridiculous。
